research_question: Whether each pre-registered model-plus-compact-scaffold system beats the named pick-trader reference under the frozen sota-v3 mechanics.

panel_design.selection_rule: Smallest allocation in the predeclared 9-20 seed and 1-3 repeat grid whose conservative-sensitivity familywise all-reject power Wilson 95% lower bound is at least 0.80.
panel_design.result: No allocation qualifies; best tested 20x3 sensitivity power is 0.2154 with Wilson 95% CI [0.207453, 0.223566].

statistical_analysis_plan.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni across the final registered model family
statistical_analysis_plan.power_definition: Probability all eight Holm-adjusted model-versus-pick-trader contrasts reject when every true lift is +40 score points.

power_model.distribution: Normal parametric Monte Carlo over seed-level lifts, evaluated with the production analyzer's exact sign-flip and Holm functions.
power_model.cross_model_covariance: Compound symmetry: one shared residual lift-seed draw per seed; model-by-seed interaction and repeat-averaged noise are independent by model.

statistical_analysis_plan.ranking_rule: No model tiers or ordinal ranking; only each registered model's predeclared contrast versus pick-trader is supported.
statistical_analysis_plan.remaining_blocker: No allocation in the evaluated 9-20 seed by 1-3 repeat grid reaches the frozen power target. A pre-data design amendment is required before seed identity can be frozen.
